text:
maria_cs: Hey team — AmberWind just requested onboarding for a custom NER for insurance claims. Key ask: PHI-aware extraction (names, policy_ids, ICD/cpt codes). They flagged renewal in ~6 weeks and want the onboarding plan + safety signoff before then. Can ENG + SAFETY + SRE review? :wave:

maria_cs: Questions from AmberWind: 1) recommended model size/quantization (7B-quant vs 13B), 2) do they need Private + HSM for keys, 3) proposed eval/safety plan, 4) capacity/latency estimate and cost ballpark.

dan_eng: Do they already have labeled data? format? that determines eval speed. For most NER we start with 7B-quant on Dedicated to get baseline; escalate to 13B if recall or PHI-leak tests fail.

maria_cs: They have ~8k labeled examples in JSONL span format. Typical sequences ~250-350 tokens. Peak target 2-3 qps. Policy: PHI must not leave their VPC; they asked explicitly about HSM for key wrapping. Contacts: Lina (AM) and Ravi (ML).

leo_safety: Important: define what they consider PHI and retention/usage constraints. We need a redaction/compare test on a small unredacted sample. Proposed metrics: entity F1 by label, PHI-leak-rate (tokens that should be redacted), and manual spot checks. Target thresholds: entity F1 >= 0.90 for critical labels; PHI-leak-rate < 0.5% on validation.

sophie_pse: I'll run enablement: 60m onboarding workshop + share a validation checklist + demo notebook. Recommend attendees: AM, ML engineer (Ravi), infra/security contact. I'll prep docs and an operations runbook.

alex_sre: Sizing Qs: what's max seq len and p95 latency SLO? With ~3 qps and 512 tokens, a quantized 7B on Dedicated usually meets p95 <500ms; estimate 1-2 GPUs (A100) depending on batching. If they want VPC-only with no egress, we should confirm Private deployment sizing.

dan_eng: Please upload a 200-example sample (mixed redacted/unredacted) to the secure bucket and share the path. I'll schedule parallel evals: 7B-quant and 13B fp16 on the sample and capture entity F1 + phi_leak_rate. Example eval command to run on our infra:

```
redwood eval run --model redwood/7b-q --dataset s3://amberwind-onboard/ner_200_sample.jsonl \
  --metrics entity_f1,phi_leak_rate --output s3://cs-results/amberwind/7b_eval_run
```

leo_safety: Safety plan outline: 1) redaction accuracy + redaction fallback if threshold fails, 2) entity F1 per-class, 3) adversarial prompt testing to surface hallucinated PHI, 4) KMS/HSM audit for key flows. Blockers: any PHI egress or unapproved key management.

alex_sre: Capacity estimate for Dedicated 7B-quant: reserve 2 x A100 to comfortably handle 2-3 qps with headroom for bursts and autoscaling. If they commit to a sustained volume we can reduce unit cost with reserved capacity. For Private/onprem we need Ravi's GPU/infra inventory to give exact sizing.

dan_eng: Proposed AB plan: run 7B-quant vs 13B-fp16 on 200 validation examples, compare entity-level recall and phi-leak. If 7B passes safety + quality thresholds we recommend sticking with 7B to save cost. I'll spin both runs in next 48h once sample is available.

maria_cs: Sample uploaded and shared to our VPC: s3://amberwind-onboard/priv/ner_200_sample.jsonl. Created Jira CS-6820 to track onboarding + safety signoff and added to renewal tracker. Lina and Ravi are looped in. Can we do a workshop Friday 9AM PT?

sophie_pse: Friday 9AM PT works for me. I'll send calendar invite and prep a short checklist + demo notebook.

leo_safety: I'll add evaluation pass/fail criteria to CS-6820 and request a 20-record manual review set flagged for high-sensitivity cases. Also add monitoring hooks: alerts for unexpected PHI output and periodic sampling.

deploy-bot: Jira CS-6820 created: "AmberWind NER onboarding - PHI handling & safety" — https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/CS-6820

alex_sre: Tentatively holding Dedicated capacity during the week of the workshop. If AmberWind confirms committed capacity we will finalize billing and pool sizing.

maria_cs: Thanks everyone — I'll update AmberWind, copy sales for renewal conversation, and mark this high priority on the renewal risk board. Follow-ups: ENG to run AB evals, SAFETY to prepare redaction/adversarial tests, SRE to confirm tentative capacity and billing. Marking action items in CS-6820. :lock:
